name: kodflow-ktn
description: ktn-linter's findings beside the prompt, as a mod (function hooks, Claude Code 2.1.299 or later). It completes the hooks ktn-linter installs and replaces none: they keep delivering the findings to the model, this mod only shows them. Active in a Go project only (the same predicate as ktn-linter's own resolver); inert where nothing draws (-p, the Agent SDK, Kepler).

activation.title: Activation
activation.description: auto: in a Go project only, as ktn-linter resolves one. always: in every project (the safety net when the probe says undetermined). off: never.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at start
autoOpen.description: Open the ktn pane when a Go session starts. Off by default: the engine seats a pane nobody asked for only from 144 columns, and once you have opened it with /ktn-view it seats it again from 110, in every later session.

scrolling.title: Scrolling
scrolling.description: window: the pane scrolls a window of the tree the daemon serves in slices, the wheel and the arrows moving it (kodflow/ktn-linter#787). native: the engine scrolls the whole tree the daemon serves (the way back).
